verdict.rationale: Private, membership-restricted teams are a fair question for a work-management product like Asana, but nothing in the evidence pack documents creating private sub-teams or limiting team membership. The pack only mentions teams as a searchable object in the MCP tools reference, scoped permissions for AI agents, and a developer sandbox with limited users. None of these is the story's capability, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create private sub-teams restricted to specific members
